items.name: SUBOCT_RANGES

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/suboct.json at 613aae1beced, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_suboct_instance.h#range_row

items.doc: The tracking range, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: low (a bass, 35 to 140 Hz), mid (70 to 280 Hz), high (140 to 560 Hz); each a row of SUBOCT_RANGE_LO_HZ, SUBOCT_RANGE_HI_HZ, SUBOCT_POST1_HZ and SUBOCT_POST2_HZ. Low comes up.

items.name: SUBOCT_OCT1_RANGE

items.doc: The octave below, percent of the tracked band divided once (omx_divider) and low-passed at the range's post1.

items.name: SUBOCT_OCT2_RANGE

source.origin: first declared in omx-dsp data/kernels/suboct.json at 613aae1beced, shipped in omx-dsp 0.27.0; implemented at include/omxdsp/fx/omx_suboct_instance.h#o2

items.doc: Two octaves below, percent: the first octave divided again and low-passed at the range's post2.

items.name: SUBOCT_DRY_RANGE

items.doc: The input, percent. With both octaves at 0 and the dry at 100 the face is the input bit for bit, the divider still tracking.
